The no-human-subjects determination is corroborated by evidence outside Element 4: the description names only cell lines (MDA-MB-468, KOLF2.1J iPSC and derived NPCs, neurons, cardiomyocytes), collection_mechanisms describe AP-MS, SEC-MS, ICC-IF microscopy and CRISPRi screens rather than participant recruitment, and direct_collection.is_direct is false with the explanation that data were generated from commercially available cell lines 'rather than collected directly from individuals'.

The stated bias is traceable to the sampling design rather than asserted in isolation: known_biases representation_bias reproduces sampling_strategies.why_not_representative almost verbatim, and both are consistent with is_representative: false and is_random: false.

total_file_count: 10 agrees with the ten enumerated file_collections entries and with distribution_formats' note that 'All ten files in the release are distributed as ZIP archives'.

All ten MD5 digests are well-formed 32-character hexadecimal strings, and per-file publication dates distinguish the 2026-06-17 tranche from the immunofluorescence archives republished 2026-07-15, which matches last_updated_on.

Governance roles are internally cross-referenced: the data_governance.committee_contact (Jillian Parker, ORCID 0000-0003-4535-3486) carries the same ORCID as the 'Parker J' creator entry, and the two ethical_reviews contact persons (Ravitsky, Belisle-Pipon) carry the same ORCIDs as their creator entries.

Embargo status is reported consistently in three places: known_limitations flags a temporary pre-publication embargo, raw_data_sources marks the two perturb-seq sources 'Embargoed', and third_party_sharing.notes repeats that they are embargoed while naming MassIVE and Figshare for the released components.

The record separates release-level facts from project-level and prior-version facts with unusual discipline: source_caveats explicitly refuses to assert cumulative project counts as release totals, and earlier-release contents are recorded under related_datasets notes rather than in this record's own slots.

The version chain is verifiable: the three is_new_version_of DOIs (K7TGEM, F3TD5R, B35XWX) match the DOIs listed in version_access.versions_available, and the October 2025 note correctly identifies AP-MS as the increment in this release.

elements.name: Dataset Evaluation and Limitations Disclosure
elements.description: Does the metadata communicate known risks, biases, or dataset limitations?

sub_elements.name: Known Limitations Documented
sub_elements.evidence: known_limitations: four typed entries, including scope_limitation 'This is an interim release and does not contain predicted cell maps, which will be added in future releases. Computed cell maps are not included in this release.' with scope_impact 'The current release is most suitable for bioinformatics analysis of the individual datasets rather than for use of the integrated cell maps'; coverage_limitation 'Protein-protein interaction (SEC-MS), protein localization (IF imaging), and CRISPRi perturb-seq data interrogate sets of proteins which incompletely overlap'; methodological_limitation 'Analysis of the release requires domain expertise for meaningful interpretation'; coverage_limitation on the pre-publication embargo of the perturb-seq subsets
sub_elements.quality_note: Limitations are categorized by type, specific, and consequential for a user's decision to reuse. The incomplete-overlap limitation in particular is the single most important caveat for anyone attempting cross-modal integration, and the scope_impact field translates the headline limitation into practical guidance about what the release is good for.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: Each limitation is corroborated elsewhere: the absent cell maps match the notes statement about the MuSIC pipeline's outputs; the embargo matches raw_data_sources access_details 'Embargoed' and third_party_sharing.notes. The disclosure is candid rather than defensive, and the honesty is consistent with source_caveats' refusal to overstate release contents.

sub_elements.name: Biases Categorized Using Standard Taxonomy (RAI-aligned)
sub_elements.evidence: known_biases: [{bias_type: representation_bias, bias_description: 'Data in this release was derived from commercially available de-identified human cell lines and does not represent all biological variants which may be seen in the population at large.'}]; future_use_impacts: absent
sub_elements.quality_note: The bias is categorized with a recognized taxonomy value (representation_bias, a BiasTypeEnum member) rather than described in free text alone, and the description identifies the actual mechanism of the bias: reliance on a small number of immortalized commercial lines rather than population-sampled material. This is the correct and most consequential bias category for a cell-line resource.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: Warning recorded: only one bias is declared, and future_use_impacts (rai:dataSocialImpact) is absent, so anticipated downstream impacts are not part of the bias analysis. Selection effects in target choice are hinted at in sampling_strategies ('Targeted selection of cell lines and perturbation targets') but not registered as a bias. The declared bias is fully consistent with sampling_strategies.is_representative: false and reproduces why_not_representative almost verbatim, so the taxonomy claim is substantiated rather than decorative.

sub_elements.name: Data Anomalies and Quality Issues Noted
sub_elements.evidence: anomalies: absent. No outliers, batch effects, imaging artifacts, failed runs, QC exclusions or per-collection quality metrics appear anywhere in the record.
sub_elements.quality_note: Nothing addresses this sub-element. For a release containing roughly 12.6 GB of confocal imaging across three treatment arms, multiple mass-spectrometry collections and a single-cell atlas, the absence of any reported anomaly, artifact or excluded run leaves a user unable to judge technical data quality. The coverage and scope caveats in known_limitations are a different kind of disclosure and are credited at sub-element 1.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: Consistent with the equally absent missing_data_documentation noted at Element 5 sub-element 5; the two gaps have the same root, namely that quality assessment of the released data is not documented. Not attributable to inapplicability: imaging and MS pipelines invariably generate QC decisions, so silence here is a documentation gap rather than an absence of subject matter.

sub_elements.semantic_validation: Consistent with human_subject_research.involves_human_subjects: false, with is_deidentified.identifiable_elements_present: false, and with the regulatory_restrictions statement that the release is not FDA regulated. The absence of content_warnings is coherent with the absence of sensitive content, so the sub-element's purpose is fully served.

sub_elements.name: Ethical Review and Social Impact Analysis
sub_elements.evidence: ethical_reviews: two entries, one naming the reviewers with contact emails and ORCIDs, one describing the methodology ('a methodology inspired by Value-Sensitive Design (VSD), facilitating the creation of normative standards and expectations aimed at ensuring the responsible design of datasets and AI technologies in alignment with core values, including the construction of an axiological repository'); data_governance.notes: the Ethics team's plan for 'ethical preparation, licensing, dissemination, and Data Access supervision ... balancing the openness of the data produced with protection of intellectual property' and the 'CM4AI Life Cycle, a framework designed to elucidate governance milestones throughout the data generation and AI system development processes'; future_use_impacts: absent

The point is awarded on this strength.

No conflicts of interest are declared either. Reviewer ORCIDs match the creators entries, and the ethics content is consistent with the prohibited_uses clinical-use restriction, which reads as a product of exactly this review process.

sub_elements.quality_note: Every relationship is typed with an appropriate vocabulary term and resolvable target, and the notes distinguish the semantics carefully: prior releases are versions, the CM4AI preprint describes the dataset, and the Nature U2OS cell map is a referenced but distinct dataset whose own repository accessions are recorded. sub_elements.semantic_validation: Relationship types are semantically correct and mutually consistent, and the version chain cross-validates against version_access.versions_available. External accessions quoted for the referenced dataset are well-formed for their repositories (MassIVE MSV-prefixed, ProteomeXchange PXD-prefixed, NDEx UUID).

strengths: Exceptional provenance discipline: source_caveats explicitly separates release-level facts from project-level and prior-version facts, declining to assert cumulative project totals (1,374 interactions, 53,788 images) as release contents and recording earlier-release contents under related_datasets instead, while flagging the upstream date anomalies in the release page.

Identifiers are consistently valid and mutually corroborating: DOI 10.18130/V3/HIGT4C (University of Virginia Dataverse prefix) appears identically in id, doi, citation and version_access.latest_version_doi; NIH award 1OT2OD032742-01 parses correctly and matches the Bridge2AI programme named in the description; 46 creators carry syntactically valid ORCIDs and ROR-identified affiliations.

Fine-grained, internally verifiable structural documentation: subpopulations states which modality covers which cell type and treatment, and every coverage claim is matched by a named subset and a file collection with an MD5 checksum, byte size and publication date, with total_file_count agreeing with the ten enumerated collections.

Strong provenance and version lineage: seven raw_data_sources with external repository locations and embargo status, a typed is_new_version_of chain whose DOIs cross-validate against version_access, per-modality producing laboratories named, and the FAIRSCAPE/ARK/EVI provenance framework identified.

Candid, actionable limitations and use guidance: four typed limitations including the crucial incomplete protein overlap across modalities and a scope_impact statement telling users what the release is actually good for, paired with reasoned prohibitions on clinical and commercial use that are consistent with the licence, IP terms and governance structure.

Substantive ethics and governance documentation for a dataset with no human participants: named and contactable ethics reviewers and governance committee contact, a described Data Access Committee review process, and an articulated Value-Sensitive Design methodology with a governance-milestone framework.
weaknesses: No software that produced or transformed the released data is named anywhere: the three processed_data collections have no associated MS search engine, image-processing software or single-cell alignment tooling, and the software that is documented occupies excluded roles (the 10x capture kit, FAIRSCAPE packaging, NDEx/Cytoscape serving, and the cellmaps pipeline whose outputs the record states are not in this release).

Processing is entirely undocumented: preprocessing_strategies, cleaning_strategies, labeling_strategies, annotation_analyses, machine_annotation_tools and imputation_protocols are all absent, so the derivation of processed collections from raw acquisition cannot be understood or replicated.

No variable-level metadata or data dictionary exists, and only the ZIP container format is declared, with internal formats and character encodings unstated, so a reuser cannot determine what files or fields the archives contain.

The release is not directly retrievable from the record: download_url is absent and the sole access URL is a truncated Dataverse API endpoint that resolves to no file, despite per-file checksums and sizes being documented.
No release-level instance counts are reported, so the size of the release in images, cells, proteins or targeted genes is unknown even though per-archive byte sizes are given.

Data quality assessment is missing: anomalies, missing_data_documentation and future_use_impacts are all absent, so technical quality issues, missingness patterns and anticipated downstream social impacts are undocumented.

Version ordering is contradictory as written: this June 2026 release is version '2.0' while the June 2025 and October 2025 releases are recorded as 'Version 2.1', and no per-deposit versioning convention is stated to reconcile them.
recommendations: Name the software that produced each processed_data collection, with versions, in preprocessing_strategies.used_software: the MS search and quantification engine for AP-MS and SEC-MS, the image processing and QC pipeline for the immunofluorescence archives, and the read alignment and guide-calling tools for the perturb-seq atlas.

Populate preprocessing_strategies and cleaning_strategies with the derivation steps from raw acquisition to each released collection, and state explicitly whether imputation was used in imputation_protocols.

Declare internal formats and encodings per collection (for example OME-TIFF for IF images, UTF-8 TSV for MS tables, H5AD or MTX for the perturb-seq atlas) and add variables entries or reference the data dictionary inside cm4ai_release_metadata.zip.

Set download_url to the release-level Dataverse landing or download URL and complete each distribution_formats.access_urls entry with its datafile persistent identifier so the archives are directly retrievable.

Report release-level counts in instances (images per treatment arm, proteins and fractions per MS collection, cells and targeted genes per perturb-seq library), which can be asserted as release facts without importing project-wide totals.

Add anomalies and missing_data_documentation entries for known QC exclusions, batch effects and imaging artifacts, and future_use_impacts entries analyzing downstream risks of models trained on cell-line-derived maps together with mitigations.

Reconcile versioning by stating that each Dataverse deposit carries an independent version counter, or renumber so that release order and version order agree, and add an errata or change entry for V2.0 recording the addition of AP-MS data and the 2026-07-15 republication of the imaging archives.

Resolve the RO-Crate conformance hedge by confirming the packaging format for this release or qualifying conforms_to_standard, and populate regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level for public non-human-subject laboratory data.
